naya.summary: CIS should let a person learn any subject with Naya, capture durable knowledge, measure progress, reflect daily, and compound understanding across time.
lessons: Learning is a recurring loop, not a one-time answer.
Assessment, notes, projects, and reflection should share one intelligence substrate.

human.summary: Naya Power should help people learn anything, remember what matters, see their progress, and get better every day.
lessons: The daily intelligence reward is part of the product magic.
Long-term value comes from compounding learning, not collecting disconnected notes.

evidence: Legacy CIS vision was read and migrated.
